- Vivek: confirm SLA exception threshold we can commit for the pilot (need an annotated decision for the deck).
- Karthik: reconcile the outstanding roadmap exceptions list with the product prioritized backlog; bring a one-slide delta for Friday.
- Ben: validate cost assumptions in slide 7 (embedding unit math) with the infra cost model.

Open risk: 1 SOC-related exception (see security-exception-log.pdf) that could affect Private deployments in EMEA if unresolved. Elena is copied for any clarifying questions from the Acme trial.

Deliverables & quick timeline:
1) Action map (attached) — owners annotated — due Thu 8/16 EOD.
2) Short decision memo for SLA exception — Vivek — due Fri 8/17 noon.
3) One-slide delta for roadmap exceptions — Karthik — due Fri 8/17 EOD.
4) Cost sanity check — Ben — Tue 8/21.

As we discussed, please reply with a single-line ack + any blocker. If you need me to escalate to Emily (CRO) or the legal team for faster turnaround on Acme-specific terms, flag it here.

Thanks —
Mina
